title: show the input password creation
rule: Show the Input — unmask: desktop hidden by default + “Show password”; mobile/tablet shown by default + hide control. Separate from login (two checks, not a fight).

citation.source: NN/g — Password Creation: 3 Ways To Make It Easier

pass_when: Creation on mobile/tablet: value shown by default with a hide control. Desktop creation: masked by default with Show password.
fail_when: Mobile/tablet creation starts masked with no hide/show path that matches shown-by-default; desktop creation has no Show; or login’s mask-by-default is treated as this creation row.
